params.caption:
🚨 Anbernic just teased its upcoming RG DDS handheld again — and this one is all about the software.

📱 The RG DDS is Anbernic's premium dual-screen retro handheld, inspired by the Nintendo 3DS.
🖥️ A new "DDS Launcher" software was shown off, built around the two screens with full customization and on-screen widgets.
🎮 The showcase footage runs The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time 3D and Ace Combat: Assault Horizon Legacy+, upscaled to 3x their original resolution.
⚙️ Specs confirmed: dual custom IPS displays + Qualcomm Snapdragon G2 Gen 2 chipset.
📦 Pre-orders are open now on Anbernic's site and AliExpress, with shipping starting gradually from December 10.

🕐 Posted: 19:54 GMT+3

📰 Sources: DLcompare

💬 Would you pick a dual-screen handheld like this over a regular one? Let us know below!

#Anbernic #RetroGaming #Handheld #GamingNews
